data.body: S2 6cd0: BLOCK G6 CRITICAL — restated schema wording 'present inside any gate run' would be FALSE: grep found 7 trace_id:None emitters, not 3. completion_verdict_assembly.py:153, completion_reconcile.py:252 and completion_failures.py:98 emit verdicts inside the completion gate scope without touching the runner; spec_scan.py:138 is not a gate op. Would have written a false contract into a signed artifact's schema. Took the narrow option: schema wording now 'null for deterministic or fallback verdicts and standalone ops', those emitters explicitly out of scope with rationale (no LLM call means no gateway request to correlate), plus an AC asserting a deterministic verdict still carries null.
